mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a tightening monetary policy or if the S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which is associated with wage inflation and can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to wage inflation or if the S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with economic growth or if the S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% does not lead to a contraction in supply or if the S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS MoM > 0.5% does not lead to a tightening monetary policy or if the S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -2% does not lead to a contraction in demand or if the S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a single month signals strong labor market conditions, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 does not correlate with economic growth or if the S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM > 1% and HOUST MoM > 1% do not lead to strong demand or if the S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.
